en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Modern lament, apparently a recent original song; I cannot name an author, so origin unclear. 'Да му кажам колку грешев' read as 'how much I erred'.

lines.cyr: Ах татко, татко, дали мислиш ти на мене
lines.lat: Ah tatko, tatko, dali misliš ti na mene
lines.en: Ah father, father, do you think of me,

lines.cyr: ах татко, татко, срце гори знај по тебе,
lines.lat: ah tatko, tatko, srce gori znaj po tebe,
lines.en: ah father, father, know that my heart burns for you,

lines.cyr: само се молам и од тебе милост барам,
lines.lat: samo se molam i od tebe milost baram,
lines.en: I only pray and ask mercy from you,

lines.cyr: за тебе горам и од болка јас ќе умрам.
lines.lat: za tebe goram i od bolka jas ḱe umram.
lines.en: I burn for you and from pain I will die.

lines.cyr: Е, е, еј, татко слушни ме,
lines.lat: E, e, ej, tatko slušni me,
lines.en: Hey, hey, hey, father, hear me,

lines.cyr: оваа песна ја пеам за тебе,
lines.lat: ovaa pesna ja peam za tebe,
lines.en: this song I sing for you,

lines.cyr: е, е, еј,
lines.lat: e, e, ej,
lines.en: hey, hey, hey,

lines.cyr: татко чекај нè, горе со мајка
lines.lat: tatko čekaj nè, gore so majka
lines.en: father, wait for us up there with mother,

lines.cyr: на едно место пак да се збереме.
lines.lat: na edno mesto pak da se zbereme.
lines.en: so we can gather again in one place.

lines.cyr: Пред гробот стојам, болка стега, солзи ронам,
lines.lat: Pred grobot stojam, bolka stega, solzi ronam,
lines.en: I stand before the grave, pain squeezes, I shed tears,

lines.cyr: кажи ми боже, дали горе ќе го видам
lines.lat: kaži mi bože, dali gore ḱe go vidam
lines.en: tell me, God, will I see him up there,

lines.cyr: за да му кажам колку грешев, колку жалам,
lines.lat: za da mu kažam kolku grešev, kolku žalam,
lines.en: to tell him how much I erred, how much I regret,

lines.cyr: кажи ми боже, за прошка да му побарам.
lines.lat: kaži mi bože, za proška da mu pobaram.
lines.en: tell me, God, so I may ask him for forgiveness.

lines.cyr: Ах татко, татко, кој нè казни, кој нè проколна,
lines.lat: Ah tatko, tatko, koj nè kazni, koj nè prokolna,
lines.en: Ah father, father, who punished us, who cursed us,

lines.cyr: без поздрав татко, тивко од нас ти си замина.
lines.lat: bez pozdrav tatko, tivko od nas ti si zamina.
lines.en: without a farewell, father, quietly you left us.

lines.cyr: И не ни кажа, збогум внуче, збогум сине,

lines.lat: bar ušte ednaš, silno tatko da te gušnevme.
lines.en: at least once more, tightly, father, we would have hugged you.
